collectible.title: Four Elements Card Deck
collectible.subtitle: Water, Earth, Fire, Air!
collectible.text: A deck of poker cards that use the four elements from Avatar: The Last Airbender—water, earth, fire, and air—instead of suits. Each card also has braille lettering, explaining how Toph can read them. Once unlocked, accessible through the Card Decks menu in the Collectibles screen.
collectible.unlock: Finish a game against Toph where Toph loses.
